title: A set that coincides with x + V near x has approximate tangent space V at x
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, x ∈ ℝ^P, V ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace with dim V = n, and δ > 0. Suppose that for every z ∈ ℝ^P with |z − x| < δ, z ∈ M ⟺ z − x ∈ V. Then V is the approximate tangent space of M at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x V): for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ), ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_V f dHⁿ as r → 0⁺, where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (δ : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → 0 < δ → (∀ z : Euclid P, dist z x < δ → (z ∈ M ↔ z - x ∈ V)) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x V
